purpose: Sixth expanded public source layer focused on marine ladder polyethers and meroterpenoids, monoterpene indole alkaloid branches, cyanobacterial peptide/PKS toxin critique, retinoid/secosteroid/bile-acid lipophiles, polyamine siderophores and acylpolyamines, host-guest supramolecular drug motifs, isotope-labeled/PET tracers, and polymer-drug conjugate linker boundaries.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate biosynthetic-anchor, host-guest, isotope-label, formulation, polymer-linker, or biological-mode policy
route-specific stereochemistry, topology, linkage, label-position, release-mechanism, and target-context review
marine-toxin, psychoactive/toxic alkaloid, cyanotoxin, endocrine-active lipophile, antimicrobial-vector, radiochemical, cytotoxic-payload, and polymer-conjugate safety review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
toxin, psychoactive alkaloid, radiochemical, cytotoxic payload, and biologically active delivery records are high-level route priors only

families.name: Marine ladder polyethers and prenylated meroterpenoids
families.strategic_principle: Separate polyepoxide or polyene cyclization logic from late oxidation and side-chain editing, and separate meroterpenoid polyketide/aromatic cores from prenyl or terpene-derived annulation modules.

families.name: Monoterpene indole alkaloid branch and rearranged skeleton expansion
families.strategic_principle: Use strictosidine/stemmadenine-like biosynthetic branch points and scaffold-rearrangement topology before applying generic indole disconnections. Psychoactive or toxic MIA targets remain compliance-gated critique records.

families.name: Cyanobacterial peptide, PKS, and toxin-like natural-product critique
families.strategic_principle: Treat cyanobacterial toxin-like and cytotoxic peptide-polyketide scaffolds as compliance-gated source records. Route critique should identify modular NRPS/PKS origin, unusual residues, macrocyclization, and payload-like risk without operational route generation.

families.name: Retinoids, secosteroids, bile acids, and endocrine-active lipophiles
families.strategic_principle: Separate lipophilic scaffold identity, polyene or steroidal geometry, side-chain oxidation state, and receptor/transport biology. Isomer geometry and endocrine activity are route-defining metadata.

families.name: Polyamine siderophores, mixed catechol/hydroxamate systems, and acylpolyamines
families.strategic_principle: Separate polyamine backbone, acyl/catechol/hydroxamate metal-binding arms, and biological vector or neuroactive context. Siderophore and venom-polyamine motifs require stewardship or toxicology review before promotion.

families.name: Macrocyclic host-guest supramolecular drug and delivery motifs
families.strategic_principle: Do not score host-guest medicines as ordinary covalent synthesis only. Separate macrocyclic host construction or selection, guest binding topology, inclusion/release mechanism, and formulation compatibility.

families.name: Isotope-labeled tracers, PET probes, and radiohalogenated imaging motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate unlabeled precursor synthesis, isotope-label position, isotope half-life or stability, radiochemical handle, and imaging-regulatory context. Labeling late-stage feasibility is a distinct strategic boundary.

families.name: Polymer-drug conjugates, PEGylated drugs, and material-bound linker motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate payload/API synthesis, polymer or material carrier selection, conjugation handle, linker cleavage or release mechanism, and distribution/polydispersity metadata before route scoring.

anchors.name: Polyepoxide cascade or prenylated meroterpenoid biosynthetic boundary
Cyanobacterial NRPS/PKS peptide or toxin-like scaffold boundary
Retinoid polyene, secosteroid, bile-acid, or hormone-like lipophile scaffold
Polyamine backbone with siderophore arms or neuroactive acyl capping groups
Macrocyclic host plus guest inclusion or controlled-release complex
Unlabeled precursor, isotope label position, and radiochemical handle
Payload, polymer/material carrier, conjugation handle, and release linker

disconnections.name: Marine ladder polyether to polyepoxide cascade precursor policy

break_bonds: selected cyclic ether C-O bonds traced to epoxide-opening cascade logic
forward_logic: map ring topology and stereochemical sequence before choosing cascade or fragment union
separate polyepoxide/polyol precursor design from late oxidation and side-chain editing
treat toxin-like ladder polyethers as route-critique records unless safety review permits promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward topology-aware ether-ring simplification; penalize intact ladder-polyether terminals with only oxidation or protecting-group changes.

evidence.citation: Marine polycyclic polyether synthesis review discusses endo-selective epoxide-opening cascades.
Marine polycyclic ether review highlights synthesis-driven stereochemical assignment challenges.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit polyepoxide topology and stereochemical cascade policy

disconnections.name: Prenylated meroterpenoid to aromatic/polyketide core plus terpene module

target_features: terpene cyclization or rearranged ring system

forward_logic: define aromatic or polyketide core separately from prenyl donor and terpene cyclization
track prenyltransferase regioselectivity, oxidative rearrangement, and ring expansion/contraction metadata
do not reduce meroterpenoids to generic aryl alkylation when mixed biosynthesis controls topology
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose the core-prenyl junction and terpene-tailoring topology.

risks: biosynthetic topology can be misleading in purely chemical routes

evidence.citation: Engineered biosynthesis review summarizes fungal meroterpenoid prenylation and tailoring strategies.
Phenalinolactone biosynthesis study illustrates sequential prenylation, epoxidation, and cyclization in terpene-polyketide scaffolds.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit core-prenyl and oxidative-tailoring policy

disconnections.name: MIA skeleton to strictosidine/stemmadenine branch-point policy

break_bonds: skeleton bond traced to strictosidine/stemmadenine-derived rearrangement branch
forward_logic: identify whether the target maps to strictosidine, stemmadenine, catharanthine/tabersonine, or yohimbane-like branches
separate biosynthetic branch topology from ordinary indole functionalization
require stereochemical and biological-context metadata before source promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward MIA branch mapping; penalize generic indole routes that ignore monoterpene-derived skeleton topology.

risks: many MIAs are potent bioactive alkaloids
plant pathway context may not translate to chemical feasibility

evidence.citation: MIA metabolic-engineering review summarizes strictosidine origin and branch-pathway logic.
Stemmadenine biosynthesis study describes conserved early steps for downstream MIA diversification.

break_bonds: skeletal rearrangement or bridged-ring bond traced to MIA branch topology
forward_logic: assign target to iboga, aspidosperma, yohimbane, sarpagine, or strychnos-like topology
separate ring-system rearrangement from late indole decoration
keep psychoactive/toxic alkaloid records in critique-only mode unless reviewed
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use as branch/topology critique; do not promote to operational generation for psychoactive or toxic alkaloids.

evidence.citation: MIA diversity review covers chemical diversity and bioactivity across Apocynaceae genera.
Rauvolfia genome study suggests multiple biosynthetic routes for yohimbane monoterpene indole alkaloids.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless branch topology and safety/legal context are explicit

disconnections.name: Cyanobacterial peptide/PKS toxin to modular assembly and unusual-residue policy

target_features: unusual amino acid or polyketide residue

forward_logic: map sequence, macrocyclization, and unusual residue boundaries
distinguish NRPS, PKS, and tailoring modules before scoring ordinary peptide routes
keep cyanotoxin records advisory and compliance-gated
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward modular assembly annotation and unusual-residue policy; reject unreviewed toxin route generation.

evidence.citation: Microcystis secondary-metabolism review discusses cyanobacterial peptide diversity and biosynthetic gene clusters.
Cyanotoxin synthesis and applications review summarizes cyanobacterial toxin classes and synthetic/biosynthetic context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless toxin review and modular annotation are explicit

disconnections.name: Dolastatin/auristatin-adjacent peptide payload to fragment and cytotoxicity policy

break_bonds: payload peptide amide or depsipeptide fragment boundary
forward_logic: separate payload-like peptide core, unusual residue fragments, and any conjugation handle
track cytotoxicity and ADC-like context separately from synthetic convergence
do not promote into proposal generation without cytotoxic payload review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Treat payload-like cyanobacterial peptides as cytotoxic source records, not ordinary peptide SAR decoration.

evidence.citation: Marine cyanobacterial anticancer-agent review covers dolastatin/auristatin-adjacent discovery and development context.
Cyanobacteria drug-discovery review discusses genetic access to cyanobacterial natural products.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless cytotoxic payload and conjugation context are reviewed

disconnections.name: Retinoid to ionone/polyene/terminal polar group and isomer policy

target_features: terminal alcohol, aldehyde, acid, or amide

forward_logic: separate hydrophobic end group, polyene geometry, and terminal polar group
track all-trans/cis isomer state and photo/thermal isomerization risk
attach receptor subtype and endocrine/developmental biology metadata to route scoring
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that preserve retinoid isomer geometry and terminal group identity.

evidence.citation: Retinoid therapeutic review covers retinol, retinoid classes, and biological context.
Retinoid SAR review discusses structure-activity relationships and therapeutic applications.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit isomer geometry and receptor-context metadata

disconnections.name: Secosteroid/bile-acid lipophile to steroidal core, side chain, and oxidation-state policy

target_features: secosteroid triene or steroidal ring system

forward_logic: separate steroidal or secosteroid scaffold source from side-chain and hydroxylation-state edits
track receptor, transporter, and endocrine context before treating analogues as stock-like
distinguish bile-acid conjugation from generic late-stage ester/amide formation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward oxidation-state and side-chain policies for endocrine lipophiles; penalize product-like steroid analogues used as stock.

evidence.citation: Vitamin D receptor modulator review discusses synthetic secosteroid analogues and disease-specific applications.
UDCA review summarizes bile-acid biosynthesis, pharmacology, and structural modification.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for side-chain, oxidation-state, and endocrine metadata

disconnections.name: Polyamine siderophore to backbone plus hydroxamate/catechol metal-binding arms

forward_logic: separate polyamine backbone, chelating arms, and microbial uptake/vector role
track denticity, metal-binding topology, and antimicrobial-vector context
avoid treating siderophore motifs as ordinary solubilizing tails
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit chelator topology and vector context; require stewardship review for antimicrobial use.

evidence.citation: Bacterial siderophore review covers classification, biosynthesis, and hydroxamate/catechol families.
Siderophore-biosynthesis targeting review discusses microbial growth and biosynthetic leverage points.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit chelator topology and uptake context

disconnections.name: Acylpolyamine natural product to polyamine chain plus acyl/aromatic cap

forward_logic: separate acyl/aromatic cap identity from polyamine chain length and branching
track protonation state and ion-channel/neuroactive context
keep venom-polyamine records advisory unless toxicology review permits use
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not treat acylpolyamines as generic amide analogues; chain topology and neuroactive context matter.

evidence.citation: Spider and wasp acylpolyamine review covers venom components, pharmacological leads, probes, and insecticidal agents.
VenoMS resource article highlights low-molecular-mass spider venom compounds including polyamine-type metabolites.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless chain topology and toxicology metadata are explicit

disconnections.name: Cyclodextrin/calixarene host-guest system to host, guest, and inclusion/release policy

break_bonds: do not force covalent bond cleavage; separate noncovalent host-guest association
forward_logic: identify macrocyclic host identity and guest binding mode
track stoichiometry, cavity fit, solubilization, and release mechanism
score host selection and guest synthesis as separate planning objects
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use host-guest records to avoid mis-scoring inclusion complexes as covalent synthesis problems.

evidence.citation: Cyclodextrin pharmaceutical review covers inclusion complexes and therapeutic applications.
Calixarene/pillararene controlled-release review summarizes macrocyclic host drug-delivery systems.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit host identity, stoichiometry, and release metadata

disconnections.name: Cucurbituril/supramolecular receptor to guest-binding and displacement policy

target_features: noncovalent binding or displacement assay context

break_bonds: guest tether or reporter attachment boundary when present
forward_logic: separate host synthesis/selection from guest structure and binding evidence
track affinity, displacement, and biological formulation role
avoid claiming route closure from host availability alone
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Score supramolecular systems through binding evidence and formulation role, not only covalent accessibility.

evidence.citation: Cucurbit[7]uril host-guest study with nabumetone and naproxen illustrates drug guest-binding characterization.
Synthetic receptor review summarizes supramolecular receptors and biomedical detection/treatment applications.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with host-guest affinity and formulation metadata

disconnections.name: PET tracer to unlabeled precursor plus late-stage fluorine-18 or carbon-11 labeling boundary

target_features: unlabeled precursor with retained binding pharmacophore

break_bonds: radiolabeled C-F, C-O, C-N, or C-C bond traced to labeling precursor
forward_logic: synthesize and qualify the unlabeled precursor separately from radiolabeling
track label position, half-life, molar activity, and biological binding retention
treat PET labeling feasibility as radiochemical metadata, not ordinary late-stage substitution
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that explicitly isolate precursor synthesis from isotope-label installation and imaging constraints.

evidence.citation: Loop radiochemistry review summarizes PET radiochemistry developments over fluorine-18 and carbon-11 tracer preparation.
Copper-mediated radiochemistry review covers radiofluorination/radiohalogenation trends for tracer synthesis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for precursor/label-position separation and radiochemical metadata

disconnections.name: Radioiodinated or stable-isotope labeled tracer to label-position and precursor policy

target_features: label position selected for imaging, quantitation, or metabolism
precursor handle for isotope exchange or radiohalogenation

break_bonds: C-I radiohalogen bond or isotope-exchange site
forward_logic: define the analytical or imaging purpose of the label position
separate precursor synthesis from isotope incorporation and purification
track isotope stability, scrambling, and regulatory handling metadata
suggested_precursor_roles: aryl boronic ester or radiohalogenation precursor
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not score isotope labels as ordinary substituents; require label-position purpose and isotope-handling metadata.

evidence.citation: Aryl-boronic ester radiohalogenation study describes divergent PET/SPECT tracer development.
Nitrogen isotope-exchange strategy article illustrates isotope-position planning and multiple isotope incorporation.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit label purpose, precursor, and stability metadata

disconnections.name: Polymer-drug conjugate to payload, carrier polymer, and degradable linker release policy

forward_logic: separate payload synthesis, linker design, polymer carrier, and conjugation chemistry
track release trigger, drug loading, polymer distribution, and formulation role
do not mark polymer-bound API routes solved from small-molecule payload synthesis alone
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit payload/linker/polymer separation and release-mechanism metadata.

evidence.citation: Polymer-drug conjugate review discusses biofunctional polymers, conjugation, and therapeutic platform roles.
Polymer-drug conjugate nanotheranostic review summarizes diagnosis/therapy and linker-carrier considerations.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for payload/linker/polymer and release metadata

disconnections.name: PEGylated or protein-polymer conjugate to biologic payload, polymer handle, and traceless/reversible linker

target_features: polymer attached to biologic or small molecule

forward_logic: separate biologic or payload identity from polymer architecture and conjugation site
track reversibility, release, immunogenicity, and pharmacokinetic design goal
treat polymer architecture and distribution as strategic route metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Score PEGylation/polymer conjugation only when conjugation site and release or PK role are explicit.

evidence.citation: PEGylation and next-generation polymer review discusses biological-barrier and polymer-carrier design issues.
Traceless linker review covers reversible protein-polymer conjugation strategies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for conjugation-site, polymer, and release/PK metadata

source_notes.summary: The v7 expansion promotes the next backlog families for marine ladder polyethers/meroterpenoids, expanded MIA alkaloid branches, cyanobacterial toxin-like peptide/PKS records, retinoid/secosteroid/bile-acid lipophiles, polyamine siderophores/acylpolyamines, host-guest supramolecular systems, isotope/PET tracers, and polymer-drug conjugates.

Marine toxin, psychoactive/toxic alkaloid, cyanotoxin, cytotoxic payload, endocrine-active lipophile, antimicrobial-vector, radiochemical, and polymer-conjugate records are advisory. Promotion to proposal generation requires explicit safety, legal, toxicology, radiochemical, stewardship, formulation, or biological-mode review as applicable.
